name: Unlicensed or cloned operator receiving payments
description: Payments go to operators, platforms or merchants that are absent from regulatory registers, imitate a legitimate firm, or process under a disguised merchant category.
fp: Registers may lag, and licences may be held by a related group entity.

links.name: Unregistered or unlicensed operator
links.ctx: Operator is absent from regulator registers or holds a licence unrelated to the activity offered.

links.name: Investment platform with unlicensed or cloned identity
links.ctx: Victim-side: payments go to a platform that lacks regulatory authorisation, imitates a legitimate firm or is hosted on a recently registered domain.

links.name: Payments to unlicensed gambling operators or via nested processors
links.ctx: Card or bank payments to merchants disguised under other categories.
